messages:
lee.sales: Heads up — Spectral AI is asking for a custom Dedicated quote. They want `30%` off list for the first 12 months + Net60 payment terms. Also asking for on‑prem/private deployment and SOC2 addendum. Need deal desk / finance sign‑off.
ariane.finance: Can you share expected ARR and spend cadence? need to see monthly burn or committed capacity to run margin.
lee.sales: Ballpark: commit $300k/yr, ramp 50% in Q1. If 30% off that’s $210k first year. Quick calc below.
lee.sales: ```
List price: $25k/mo -> $300k/yr
30% discount => $210k/yr
Estimated infra+ops cost: $95k/yr
Gross margin ≈ 55% (~$115k)
```
ariane.finance: Need to load this into the deal desk model and check precedent. Any strategic offsets (reference, case study, cofunding) that justify deeper discount?
chris.custsuccess: They said they'd be willing to be a launch partner for our private deployment and participate in a joint PR + reference. Also they'll co-fund an integration effort. Renewal risk: moderate but higher if we don’t lock in reference.
sam.revenueops: Two operational asks: 1) Net60 requires CFO exception — finance approval process. 2) On‑prem should be priced as Private (license + infra uplift) plus a one‑time deployment fee and SRE support days. Also KMS/HSM integration has an engineering cost.
parth.legal: We need to ensure on‑prem indemnities/data clauses are scoped. SOC2 addendum ok but will add review time. Don’t reopen IP language. I can draft the amendment once pricing is agreed.
ariane.finance: Proposal: deployment fee $50k one‑time + 20% uplift for on‑prem ops. Finance can approve up to `20%` discount if they sign a 12‑month PO and pay net45. Anything else to surface?
lee.sales: Customer pushing for 30%. Counter idea: `25%` first year + $50k deployment fee + quarterly milestone payments (net30 after milestones). That reduces credit risk.
sam.revenueops: Milestone payments are preferable. Also recommend adding an accelerator if they exceed committed usage to preserve upside.
pricing-bot: Pricing model (internal): https://redwoodinternal/pricing/deal-desk/spectral-ai — includes precedent table and margin sim.
ariane.finance: I can greenlight up to `22%` with the $50k deployment fee + net45, subject to legal ammendment. Anything above that needs CFO signoff.
parth.legal: I’ll fast‑track the SOC2 addendum and prepare the net60 exception language. Send me the exact payment schedule for the milestone approach.
chris.custsuccess: :thumbsup: I'm comfortable with up to 22% if we get the reference + deployment fee. That earns us the PR value.
lee.sales: I’ll push for 25% + $50k deployment + quarterly milestones and ask for net45. If they accept, can we aim for final sign‑off EOD tomorrow?
ariane.finance: @sam.revenueops quick sanity check on margin with 25% + one‑time deployment?
sam.revenueops: With `25%` discount + $50k deployment the first‑year CAC‑adjusted gross margin ≈ 50%. For a strategic pilot with reference, that’s acceptable. Recommend approval route w/ CFO notification.
ariane.finance: Provisional approval: up to `25%` provided conditions met — $50k one‑time deployment fee, net45 terms, legal amendment (SOC2 & payment schedule), and PR/reference commitment. I will loop CFO for the net60 exception if they insist. Lee, update term sheet and tag me.
lee.sales: Will do. Thanks all — I’ll push the revised term sheet and loop legal + ariane once I have customer agreement.
